flow-definition.description: Enterprise Universal Application Delivery Platform - Golden Path Multi-Cloud & Multi-Account Deployment Engine

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: APPLICATION
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Approved application identifier registered in the central catalog.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: TARGET_PLATFORM
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Cloud provider target: Floci local simulation (floci-local / floci) or Real AWS Cloud (aws).

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: ACCOUNT_TOPOLOGY
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Account isolation topology: Multi-Account (STS AssumeRole isolation) or Single-Account (ABAC / prefix isolation).

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: ACTION
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Execution lifecycle phase: DEPLOY executes full promotion; PLAN_ONLY stops after Terraform plan; VALIDATE_ONLY checks catalog & specs; BUILD_RELEASE produces release manifest.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: RELEASE_ID
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Optional immutable Release ID (e.g. rel-20261106173000). Auto-generated if omitted.
